# Yassine Chandid — Full Stack Developer

> Yassine Chandid is a full-stack developer based in Casablanca, Morocco (UTC+1). He builds fast, modern web, mobile, and desktop apps with React, Next.js, and TypeScript — then ships them and keeps them running. This site (yassinech.com) is his portfolio: selected work, a full project index, and small free developer tools.

## About

- Name: Yassine Chandid
- Role: Full Stack Developer / Software Engineer
- Location: Casablanca, Morocco (UTC+1)
- Focus: React, Next.js, TypeScript, full-stack web, mobile (React Native), desktop
- Contact: me@yassinech.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/jakcal
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/chandid_yassine

## Featured projects

- AnimeHub — Anime streaming app. 5M+ downloads.
- Modus — Business management system: stock, orders, customers, multi-organization workspaces, and a hospitality module (hostels and short-stay rentals) with a direct-booking storefront. In production. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/modus)
- MockupViews — Canvas mockup & video studio. 2k+ daily users. [Case study](https://yassinech.com/projects/mockupviews)

## Tools

- [Markdown to PDF](https://yassinech.com/MarkdownToPdf): Paste Markdown, get a clean PDF. Runs fully in the browser — nothing uploaded. Source: https://github.com/jakcal/MarkdownToPdf
- [Stateless Password Generator](https://yassinech.com/stateless-password-generator): Same settings always produce the same strong password, so nothing is stored. Source: https://github.com/jakcal/stateless-password-generator
